item.title: MacPass 0.8.3.5
item.description:
Changes since 0.8.3.4:

  • History: release 0.8.3.4, and the fork on pro
  • README: changes are no longer offered upstream
  • History: 0.8.3.4 on three Macs, a change to the same entry on two left unsaved
  • History: a1 runs the release 0.8.3.4, the Debug build lacked the Accessibility grant
  • Search looks everywhere by default
  • Save a merge whose change is in a group instead of taking it for none
  • History: a merge below the root group was taken for none, fixed, not released
